title: AI Spokesperson Videos for UGC Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Get an AI actor who holds your product and speaks one clear line to camera, so a feature is explained in a selfie-style ad without hiring a presenter.
h1: AI Spokesperson Videos With a Speaking Actor
lead: Some products sell once a feature is explained out loud, but booking a presenter and a set for one line is expensive and slow. Choose an adult AI actor who holds your product and speaks your line to camera, then use the clip as a brand-led ad instead of an invented review.
benefits_h2: Why use an AI spokesperson video?

benefits.d: A face-to-camera line tells shoppers what the part does and why it matters, which is harder to show in a photo alone.

benefits.t: No presenter or set to book
benefits.d: Pick an AI actor and setting, then generate the clip from a product photo without a casting, studio or sample shipment.
Write one supportable line yourself, so the ad stays factual and never invents a customer testimonial.

benefits.t: Time for a fuller product story
benefits.d: Choose up to 30 seconds when the feature needs an action and a clear final hold, not just a quick product flash.

steps_h2: How to make a spokesperson video in 3 simple steps
steps_lead: Three steps give you a speaking presenter who holds your product — no casting, no studio day.

steps.d: Upload a clear full view with the shape, color and label area visible. It lets the presenter hold the item at a believable scale.
Pick an adult AI actor, a familiar setting and a delivery style that fit your audience, with one simple on-screen action.
Write one short, factual line, review the voice and visuals, then download. Add captions and offers in your editor.

faq.q: Can an AI actor speak in a product ad?
faq.a: Yes. Add a short spoken line and the generated presenter can deliver it while showing your product. Keep the line short enough for a calm delivery and a clear product hold. Read the line at normal speed before generation so the final hold does not feel rushed.

faq.q: Can I choose the actor’s appearance and setting?
faq.a: Choose from the available adults, age ranges and scenes. The presenter may vary slightly between generated results. A neutral setting and steady framing keep attention on the item.

faq.q: Is the presenter a real customer?
faq.a: No. The presenter is AI-generated. Do not describe the actor as a real buyer or user. Use a disclosure label where required and avoid implying personal use.

faq.q: Can an AI actor give a testimonial?
faq.a: Do not invent a customer testimonial. Use only real, authorized customer words, or write a brand-led product explanation. A brand explanation can describe the feature without inventing a review. Keep the wording factual and tie each benefit to a product detail you can support.

faq.q: Which products work well in these videos?
faq.a: Handheld products such as skincare, apparel accessories, jewelry, pet supplies, snacks, drinks, fitness items and phone accessories are easy to show clearly. Choose a product with a shape or action that stays visible in one hand.

faq.q: Can the presenter hold the exact product?
faq.a: Yes. Provide a clear product reference and describe how the presenter should hold or demonstrate it. Describe the hand position and final pose to reduce product drift.

faq.q: Can I avoid a script burned into the image?
faq.a: Yes. Keep spoken copy and any captions in your video or page layer rather than the source image. Add subtitles after generation so you can correct names, prices and timing.

faq.q: How long should the spoken line be?
faq.a: Use one short sentence that names the product and one useful feature. A focused line leaves time for the presenter to hold the item steady, show its action and finish without rushing the viewer. Read the line aloud before generation and check the final audio against the written copy.

faq.q: Can this video run as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and can be used commercially, so the spoken ad can go straight into TikTok, Reels or YouTube campaigns. Identify the presenter as AI-generated where the platform requires it, and put prices or offers in your ad tool.

faq.q: Is an AI spokesperson the same as hiring a UGC creator?
faq.a: No. A UGC creator films themselves with the real product and can improvise; an AI spokesperson speaks the line you write and is generated from your product photo. Use the presenter for a brand explanation, not as a personal customer story.

overview.h2: Let the presenter provide context, not a testimonial
overview.p: A presenter can show a product’s size and shape in a familiar setting. Keep the item near the center of the shot, with room for its details to show.

examples.lead: Use one presenter, one product detail and one short line so the scene stays easy to review.

cards.label: Car selfie review: serum pump
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. In a parked car, an adult creator holds the serum beside their face and says: “Here is the pump detail I wanted to show.” They turn it once toward the lens. Front-camera chest-up selfie, natural daylight, realistic skin, slight handheld sway. End with the serum held steady beside the creator’s face, pump visible. Sound: clear speech and soft car ambience; no music, text or logos.

Direct-to-camera selfie, natural light, realistic skin. End with the moisturizer beside the cheek and the applied layer visible. Sound: clear speech and quiet room tone; no music, text or logos.

Chest-up front-camera view, natural skin, soft daylight. End with the shaker upright and its opened cap facing camera. Sound: speech and a light shaker rattle; no music, text or logos.

cards.label: Office setup: phone stand
cards.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a home-office desk, an adult creator opens a folding phone stand and says: “If your phone keeps sliding on calls, this stand holds the angle in place.” They set a phone into the cradle. Handheld eye-level selfie, window light. End with the phone seated upright in the open stand cradle. Sound: speech and a light hinge click; no music, text or logos.

uses.d: An adult presenter speaks to camera while holding a useful everyday product at a clear scale. Keep the item beside the face or hands so its size, finish and one feature are easy to see. Keep the frame steady while the presenter names one supported feature. Choose a crop close enough to inspect the finish, but leave the actor’s hands visible for scale.

A direct-to-camera line makes a product feature easy to follow in a feed. Add captions, price and offer text after download, and identify the AI actor where the platform requires disclosure. Keep the opening claim short enough to read before the feed moves on. Use a short caption that repeats the supported feature and keeps the disclosure easy to find.
